svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 360 x 180 x 6 mm. Cut square, file the edges, round the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corners to about 3 mm. Scribe a centre line along the long side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rail holes: three on the centre line, at the middle and 150 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of it. Drill 3.3 mm right through and tap M4.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner holes: four 5.5 mm holes, 12 mm in from each long and short

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, for screwing the plate to a wall or cabinet later.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole on both faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underneath: four stick-on rubber feet, 20 mm across, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 mm each side of the middle and 60 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the rail lies on the centre line, held by three M4 x 6 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pan-head screws through its base into the tapped holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an M4 screw runs into each hole by hand; the plate rocks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on none of its feet on a flat bench.
